$Comment: Percent points added to the chance of a bonus find on a hand harvest, in whole percent points: the harvesting line of GatherYield, counted where a mod names it for a harvest (ziggfreed-common's gather stat sources), beside GatherYield itself, so it raises a find's odds and never rolls a second time. Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
